chapters.title: Be Strong and of Good Courage
chapters.synopsis: After the death of Moses, the Lord commissions Joshua to lead Israel over Jordan into the promised land. He commands him to meditate in the book of the law day and night and promises to be with him as He was with Moses. Joshua directs the people to prepare, and they pledge their obedience.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Be strong and of a good courage

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Joshua commands the people to prepare

segments.speaker: israelites
segments.note: All that thou commandest we will do

chapters.title: Rahab Hides the Spies
chapters.synopsis: Joshua sends two spies to view Jericho, and Rahab hides them on her roof from the king's men. She confesses that the Lord has given Israel the land, and the spies covenant to spare her household, marked by a scarlet cord in the window. The spies return and report that the inhabitants faint because of Israel.

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Rahab hides the two spies

segments.speaker: rahab
segments.note: Rahab confesses the Lord gave Israel the land

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: The scarlet cord covenant; the spies return

chapters.title: Jordan Stands in a Heap
chapters.synopsis: Israel follows the ark of the covenant to the edge of Jordan at flood stage. When the priests' feet touch the water, the river stands in a heap and the nation crosses on dry ground. The miracle certifies that the living God is among them and magnifies Joshua before all Israel.

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Israel follows the ark to Jordan

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: This day will I magnify thee

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Hereby ye shall know the living God

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: The waters stand; Israel crosses dry

chapters.title: Twelve Stones of Memorial
chapters.synopsis: At the Lord's command, twelve men carry twelve stones from the midst of Jordan to build a memorial at Gilgal. The stones are to prompt children in later generations to ask their meaning, so the crossing will never be forgotten. All the earth is to know that the hand of the Lord is mighty.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Take twelve stones out of Jordan

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: The memorial raised at Gilgal

chapters.title: The Captain of the Lord's Host
chapters.synopsis: In the plains of Jericho the new generation is circumcised, rolling away the reproach of Egypt, and Israel keeps the passover. The manna ceases as the people eat the fruit of the land. A man with a drawn sword appears to Joshua and declares himself captain of the host of the Lord.

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Circumcision and passover; the manna ceases

segments.speaker: angel
segments.note: The captain of the Lord's host appears

chapters.title: The Walls of Jericho Fall
chapters.synopsis: Following the Lord's strange battle plan, Israel circles Jericho once a day for six days, and seven times on the seventh. At the trumpet blast and the people's shout the wall falls down flat, and the city is destroyed. Rahab and her father's household are saved alive as promised.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: I have given into thine hand Jericho

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: The wall falls; Rahab is spared

chapters.title: Achan Troubles Israel
chapters.synopsis: Achan secretly takes of the accursed spoil of Jericho, and Israel is shamefully beaten at Ai. Joshua tears his clothes before the ark, and the Lord reveals that Israel has sinned and cannot stand until the sin is purged. Achan is found out by lot, confesses, and is executed in the valley of Achor.

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Israel is smitten before Ai

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Joshua pleads before the ark

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Israel hath sinned; sanctify the people

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Achan confesses and is judged

chapters.title: Ai Taken by Ambush
chapters.synopsis: The Lord directs Joshua to take Ai by an ambush set behind the city, and this time the stratagem succeeds completely. Afterward Joshua builds an altar on mount Ebal, writes a copy of the law of Moses, and reads every word of the law, the blessings and cursings, before all the congregation.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Fear not; lay thee an ambush

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Ai falls to the ambush

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: The law read at mount Ebal

chapters.title: The Gibeonites' Cunning Covenant
chapters.synopsis: Fearing destruction, the Gibeonites come to Joshua in old garments with mouldy bread, pretending to be from a far country. Israel makes a league with them without asking counsel of the Lord. When the ruse is discovered the oath still stands, and the Gibeonites become hewers of wood and drawers of water.

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Gibeon deceives Israel into a league

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: The deception found out; the oath honored

chapters.title: The Day the Sun Stood Still
chapters.synopsis: Five Amorite kings attack Gibeon, and Israel marches all night to its defense. The Lord casts down great hailstones, and at Joshua's word the sun stands still upon Gibeon until the people avenge themselves. Joshua then sweeps through the south country, taking its cities and kings.

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Israel rescues Gibeon; hailstones fall

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: The five kings and the south subdued

chapters.title: The Northern Kings Subdued
chapters.synopsis: Jabin king of Hazor gathers a vast northern confederacy with horses and chariots very many. Joshua falls upon them suddenly at the waters of Merom and destroys them, burning Hazor. The long war ends, and the land rests from war.

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: The northern confederacy destroyed at Merom

chapters.title: The Roll of Conquered Kings
chapters.synopsis: The record lists the kings defeated by Israel: Sihon and Og beyond Jordan under Moses, and thirty-one kings west of Jordan under Joshua. The catalogue stands as a witness of the Lord's faithfulness in giving the whole land.

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: The kings conquered east and west of Jordan

chapters.title: Land Yet to Be Possessed
chapters.synopsis: Joshua is old, and the Lord names the regions that remain unconquered, promising to drive out their inhabitants. The inheritance of Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh east of Jordan, given by Moses, is rehearsed. Levi receives no land, for the Lord is their inheritance.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: There remaineth yet very much land

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: The eastern tribes' inheritance rehearsed

chapters.title: Caleb Claims His Mountain
chapters.synopsis: As the division of Canaan by lot begins, Caleb reminds Joshua of the promise made forty-five years before, when he wholly followed the Lord as a spy. Still strong at eighty-five, he asks for the mountain of the Anakims, and Joshua blesses him and gives him Hebron.

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: The division by lot begins

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Caleb asks for and receives Hebron

chapters.title: The Inheritance of Judah
chapters.synopsis: The borders and cities of the tribe of Judah are described in detail, from the wilderness of Zin to the great sea. Caleb drives out the sons of Anak from Hebron, and Othniel wins Achsah his daughter. The Jebusites, however, remain unconquered in Jerusalem.

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Judah's borders and cities listed

chapters.title: The Lot of Ephraim
chapters.synopsis: The children of Joseph receive their inheritance, and the borders of Ephraim are traced through the hill country from Bethel toward the sea. The Canaanites of Gezer are not driven out but serve under tribute.

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Ephraim's borders described

chapters.title: The Portion of Manasseh
chapters.synopsis: Manasseh receives its lot west of Jordan, and the daughters of Zelophehad claim the inheritance promised them by Moses. The children of Joseph complain that their portion is too small, and Joshua tells them to prove their strength by clearing the wooded hill country and driving out the Canaanites.

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Manasseh's lot; Joseph's complaint answered

chapters.title: The Land Divided at Shiloh
chapters.synopsis: The tabernacle is set up at Shiloh, and Joshua rebukes seven tribes still slack to possess their land. Surveyors describe the remaining country in a book, and lots are cast before the Lord. Benjamin's inheritance falls between Judah and Joseph.

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: The land surveyed and cast by lot

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Benjamin's borders and cities

chapters.title: The Last Lots Are Drawn
chapters.synopsis: The remaining six tribes receive their inheritances by lot at Shiloh: Simeon, Zebulun, Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and Dan. When the dividing is finished, Israel gives Joshua his own inheritance, Timnath-serah in mount Ephraim, and he builds his city there.

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Six tribes' lots; Joshua's inheritance

chapters.title: Cities of Refuge Appointed
chapters.synopsis: The Lord commands Israel to appoint the cities of refuge spoken of by Moses, where one who kills a person unawares may flee from the avenger of blood. Six cities are set apart on both sides of Jordan, that the slayer may stand before the congregation for judgment.

segments.speaker: the-lord
segments.note: Appoint the cities of refuge

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Six cities set apart

chapters.title: Cities for the Levites
chapters.synopsis: The Levites receive forty-eight cities with their suburbs out of every tribe, as the Lord commanded by Moses. The record closes with the testimony that the Lord gave Israel all the land He sware to give: there failed not ought of any good thing which the Lord had spoken.

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Forty-eight Levite cities assigned

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Not one good promise failed

chapters.title: The Altar of Witness
chapters.synopsis: Joshua blesses the eastern tribes and sends them home to their inheritance beyond Jordan. When they build a great altar by the river, the western tribes gather for war, fearing rebellion against the Lord. The easterners explain it is not for sacrifice but a witness that they too have a part in the Lord.

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Joshua blesses the eastern tribes homeward

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: The altar Ed: a witness, not rebellion

chapters.title: Joshua's Farewell Charge
chapters.synopsis: Old and stricken in age, Joshua gathers Israel's leaders and rehearses all the Lord has fought for them. He charges them to be very courageous to keep the law, to cleave unto the Lord, and to make no marriages with the remaining nations, lest the good land be lost.

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Joshua, old, gathers Israel's leaders

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Cleave unto the Lord your God

chapters.title: Choose You This Day
chapters.synopsis: At Shechem Joshua rehearses the Lord's dealings from Abraham to the conquest, then demands a decision: choose you this day whom ye will serve, but as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord. The people covenant to serve the Lord, and a great stone is set up as witness. Joshua dies at a hundred and ten years old.

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Joshua rehearses the Lord's mighty acts

segments.speaker: joshua
segments.note: Choose you this day whom ye will serve

segments.speaker: israelites
segments.note: The people covenant to serve the Lord

segments.note: The witness stone; Joshua dies
